cc:Work.dc:title: MMLU-Pro Candidate accuracy by repetitions
cc:Work.dc:description: Candidate accuracy across question and repetition allocations using 1,000 responses per model. The line shows the group mean and shading shows ±1 observed standard deviation across 20 groups. The dotted reference uses 1,000 MMLU-Pro questions × 20 repetitions.
